notes.title: Ego Hearts 1.2 update
notes.notes:
¡Hola!
Hallo!

We are happy to present you Ego Hearts update 1.2 with Spain and German localizations! Thanks to David de la Nuez from https://alfabetagame.wordpress.com/ for Spain translation, and to Benjamin Geßner for German translation. 

February is going to the end, and more than 3.5k people have played Ego Hearts. Spring is coming soon, and it's all your merit. Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.1 for Ego Hearts in avaliable now!
notes.notes:
What we've done:

 Improved controls for better experience.
 Made the game a bit easier.
 Improved gameplay hints.
 Remade english localization - thanks to our player Kateland Lawton, who did a great job in proofreading and editing!
 Redrew some masks.
 Fixed small bugs.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34326627/90ded052fe728096d3798c32af4fd8e01e324d0d.png

Give it a try, it is still free! And feel free to share your story and gameplay interpretations, with overall expressions about this update!

P.S.: If you want to help us with translation of our game to your language - you're welcome! Just write me right here, in the comments, or send me an e-mail: 
contact@ironictitle.com

notes.title: Ego Hearts release
notes.notes:
Ego Hearts is avaliable now!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34326627/90ded052fe728096d3798c32af4fd8e01e324d0d.png
Ego Hearts is a small interactive reflection about death and what do we leave behind it.
Take a paper plane and share your warmth to get rid off the frost.

notes.title: Ego Hearts OST release
notes.notes:
Today we have released official soundtrack of Ego Hearts. It is already avaliable for listening on your favourite music steaming services. 
Soundtrack as a DLC is gonna be avaliable here right after the game release.

Game is gonna be avaliable after a week, so, make sure it's already on your wishlist!
